messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-runtime region=eu-west-1 — metric=latency_p99 value=2.82s (> SLO 1.5s). Incident INC-8412 paged oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page sent to isabel (oncall). Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-8412

isabel (oncall): ack — i'm on it. Pinging infra and runtime teams. starting triage.

ravi (eng-runtime): looking at traces, seems concentrated on model=gpt-small-quant-v2 on gpux-eu-3. KV cache miss rate jumped after a deploy at ~11:03 UTC.

cheng (infra): host metrics show GPU mem spike on gpux-eu-3, autoscaler got throttled by quota-limiter (HTTP 403). scale-up requests queued.

isabel (oncall): can we divert traffic away from gpux-eu-3? what's fastest mitigation?

ravi (eng-runtime): two quick options: route traffic cross-region (adds RTT) or rollback to previous model version that had warmer KV locality. i'll attempt rollback to v1.8. Command: `./deploy roll runtime --service=inference --model=gpt-small-quant-v2 --to-version=1.8` — kicking it off.

incident-bot: note: rollback initiated by isabel (oncall). estimated completion ~2m.

sara (cs): any visible customer impact? support ticket #4521 from AcmePayments reporting slow EU requests.

cheng (infra): reissued autoscaler quota request to cloud team, escalated. will post update when quota increases.

isabel (oncall): also toggled prefer_hot_cache flag to true to reduce cold-KV misses: `PATCH /config/routing prefer_hot_cache=true`. starting synthetic warmups.

ravi (eng-runtime): running warmup script: `python tools/warm_kv.py --model gpt-small-quant-v2 --targets 50`. warming common prefixes now. KV miss rate should drop within a few minutes.

ops-bridge: log tail:
```
[11:05:14] gpux-eu-3 - kv_miss=0.72 latency_p99=2.75
[11:08:20] gpux-eu-3 - kv_miss=0.18 latency_p99=1.12
```

isabel (oncall): looking at dashboard — p99 trending down, current p99 ~1.1s. holding further PD escalations for now.

pagerduty: Incident INC-8412 status changed to acknowledged by isabel.

ravi (eng-runtime): rollback completed on gpux-eu pools without errors. warmers still running for another 10m.

sara (cs): updated AcmePayments: "we saw a latency spike in EU, mitigations applied, monitoring. will follow up after postmortem."

cheng (infra): cloud quota team responded and increased soft quota; follow-up ticket to ensure autoscaler doesn't get suppressed by default.

isabel (oncall): moving to monitoring phase. Follow-ups I want in the postmortem: 1) add model_version dimension to latency alerts, 2) reduce suppression window for autoscaler quota errors, 3) add automated KV warmers post-deploy. filing INF-1937 now.

ravi (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause hypothesis: packing/quantization change in v2 altered memory layout causing more KV evictions under load -> cold prefix misses -> tail latency. will add canary that exercises warm paths.

sara (cs): i'll keep customer loop closed; no escalations required at present.

isabel (oncall): handing off to @cheng for a 2hr watch. next scheduled oncall @alex (oncall) at 13:00 UTC. if stable for 30m, i'll close PD incident.

incident-bot: note: last message in thread at 6200012645 — thread remains open for follow-up tasks and postmortem.
